left.raw_text: Generally healthy, postmenopausal woman who seeks treatment for hot flushes.
Meets 1 of the following: At least 12 months of spontaneous amenorrhea
, At least 6 months of spontaneous amenorrhea with serum follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) levels > 40 mIU/mL
, At least 6 weeks postsurgical bilateral oophorectomy (with or without hysterectomy). Hysterectomized without bilateral oophorectomy and with serum FSH levels >40 mIU/mL.
